errors.evidence: There is a typo in the Bulgarian word for "Strongly". It is written as "Сильно" but should be "Силно". This error appears twice.

The description does not mention the y-axis label or units. While it correctly infers that the values are percentages from the data point labels, it fails to state that the axis itself represents percentages.

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия за "2 По-скоро съгласен" започва на 25%, намалява леко до 20% за 26-34
errors.evidence: The description for the orange line is incorrect. It starts at 13% (not 25%) and increases to 26% (not decreases to 20%). The values 25% and 20% belong to the grey and yellow lines, respectively.

errors.text_span: Сивата линия, съответстваща на "3 Не мога да преценя", започва от 13%
errors.evidence: The grey line, representing "Не мога да преценя", starts at 25% for the 19-25 age group, not 13%. The value 13% is the starting point for the orange line.

In the description of the yellow line ("По-скоро несъгласен"), it incorrectly states that the value for the 26-34 age group is 26%. The actual value shown on the chart for this point is 20%. The value 26% belongs to the orange line in that same age group.

errors.text_span: Тъмносинята линия за "5 Силно несъгласен" започва на 12%
errors.evidence: The description claims the dark blue line starts at 12% for the 19-25 age group. However, the chart shows no data point for this series in the 19-25 age group. The line begins at 2% in the 26-34 age group. The value 12% is taken from the 35-44 age group for this same series.
